rows.speaker: Shaya
rows.en: Brings back memories. This is the trading point where we all first met, isn't it?
rows.display_text:
「Brings back memories. This is where we
all first met, isn't it?」

rows.speaker: Elchi
rows.en: That's right. We fought all sorts of enemies here, and then Captain Lowen showed up...
rows.display_text:
「That's right. We fought enemies here,
then Captain Lowen showed up...」

rows.speaker: Talho
rows.en: Sure, but if I recall, we didn't want to get dragged into it, so we ran off.
rows.display_text:
「Sure, but if I recall, we didn't want to
get dragged in, so we ran off.」

rows.speaker: Heizaemon
rows.en: So our battle begins again, here in this land...
rows.display_text:
「So our battle begins again in this
land...」

rows.speaker: Ichitaro
rows.en: Everyone, $c from North Ameria is here.
rows.display_text:
「Everyone, $c from North Ameria is
here.」

rows.speaker: Meyrin
rows.en: I've confirmed each of $c's ships.
rows.display_text: 「I've confirmed each of $c's ships.」

rows.speaker: Lacus
rows.en: It's been a while, everyone.
rows.display_text: 「It's been a while, everyone.」

rows.speaker: Dianna
rows.en: I can't say I'm glad for a reunion under these circumstances, but let's first confirm everyone's safety.
rows.display_text:
「I can't say I'm glad for a reunion like
this, but let's first confirm everyone's
safety.」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: I hear some promising intelligence has come in. I'd like to move straight into a briefing.
rows.display_text:
「I hear promising intel has come in. I'd
like to move straight into a briefing.」

rows.speaker: Gengoro
rows.en: Understood. I'll get the crew assembled.
rows.display_text: 「Understood. I'll get the crew assembled.」

rows.speaker: Heizaemon
rows.en: A new enemy of unknown identity... and to face them, comrades gathered together beyond nation and standing...
rows.display_text:
「A new enemy of unknown identity... to
face them, comrades gathered beyond
nation and standing...」

rows.speaker: Heizaemon
rows.en: Now then... how shall we see this fight through...
rows.display_text:
「Now, how shall we see this fight
through...」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: Been a while, Shinn. Figured you'd be here too.
rows.display_text:
「Been a while, Shinn. Figured you'd be
here too.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: Every nation's cooperating on this operation. Kira, Athrun, and the Archangel are here too.
rows.display_text:
「Every nation's cooperating on this op.
Kira, Athrun, and the Archangel are here
too.」

rows.speaker: Touga
rows.en: So Kamille and the others are here as well, huh.
rows.display_text:
「So Kamille and the others are here too,
huh.」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: The AEUG members were folded straight into the Federation forces, so we're all here, present and accounted for.
rows.display_text:
「The AEUG members were folded straight
into the Federation forces, so we're all
here, accounted for.」

rows.speaker: Luna
rows.en: Huh...? Didn't Lt. Quattro leave the military?
rows.display_text:
「Huh...? Didn't Lt. Quattro leave the
military?」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: It's an emergency, after all. The Lieutenant's come back temporarily too, and he's taking overall command.
rows.display_text:
「It's an emergency. The Lieutenant's
come back temporarily too, and he's
taking overall command.」

rows.speaker: Koji
rows.en: Feels kind of strange. Not that long ago you all were fighting the Federation.
rows.display_text:
「Strange, huh -- not long ago, you all
were fighting the Federation.」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: What the AEUG was fighting was the Titans faction that had seized control of the Federation from the inside.
rows.display_text:
「The AEUG was fighting the Titans
faction that had seized control of the
Federation from the inside.」

rows.speaker: Amuro
rows.en: Now that they've been swept away, returning to the Federation forces is only natural.
rows.display_text:
「Now that they're swept away, returning
to the Federation forces is only natural.」

rows.speaker: Emma
rows.en: Although, both the Federation and ZAFT are still caught up in internal turmoil, same as every other nation...
rows.display_text:
「Although, the Federation and ZAFT are
still in internal turmoil, like every other
nation...」

rows.speaker: Emma
rows.en: ...so our own standing is still up in the air, honestly.
rows.display_text:
「...so our standing's still up in the air,
honestly.」

rows.speaker: Kira
rows.en: Even so, we have to keep fighting. We carry the hopes of so many people from the last war on our shoulders.
rows.display_text:
「Even so, we must keep fighting. We
carry the hopes of so many from the last
war on our shoulders.」

rows.speaker: Shinn
rows.en: The hopes of the people who fought for the future... I'll make sure to carry them on.
rows.display_text:
「Hopes of those who fought for the
future... I'll make sure to carry them on.」

rows.speaker: Athrun
rows.en: Every last one of us in $c shares that same feeling.
rows.display_text:
「Every last one of us in $c shares
that same feeling.」

rows.speaker: Harry
rows.en: Lady Dianna has also set aside her life as an Earth-dweller for now, and is standing at the front lines as Queen of the Moon.
rows.display_text:
「Lady Dianna too has set aside her life
on Earth for now, standing at the front
lines as Queen of the Moon.」

rows.speaker: Tetsuya
rows.en: Everyone... really is of one mind, aren't they.
rows.display_text:
「Everyone really is of one mind, aren't
they.」

rows.speaker: Garrod
rows.en: Yeah, that's right. We're fighting so that the same mistakes and sorrow never happen again.
rows.display_text:
「Yeah, that's right. We fight so the
same mistakes and sorrow never happen
again.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: You're...!
rows.display_text: 「You're...!」

rows.speaker: Setsuko
rows.en: It's been a long time. I'm glad to see you're doing well.
rows.display_text:
「It's been a long time. I'm glad to see
you're doing well.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: Setsuko! You're safe!
rows.display_text: 「Setsuko! You're safe!」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: We'd lost contact with you, so we were worried, sis.
rows.display_text:
「We'd lost contact, so we were worried,
sis.」

rows.speaker: Setsuko
rows.en: I'm sorry. I've caused you all trouble.
rows.display_text: 「Sorry. I've caused you all trouble.」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: Setsuko... who's this?
rows.display_text: 「Setsuko... who's this?」

rows.speaker: Setsuko
rows.en: This is $F, the repairman who looked after me.
rows.display_text:
「This is $F, the repairman who looked
after me.」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: Mister $l. Let me offer my own thanks, for what you did for my subordinate.
rows.display_text:
「Mister $l. Let me offer my thanks for
what you did for my subordinate.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Subordinate, huh? So you folks are Setsuko's comrades?
rows.display_text:
「Subordinate? So you folks are Setsuko's
comrades?」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: Yeah, more or less. It's a bit of a story, but we've put together a new team.
rows.display_text:
「Yeah, more or less. It's a bit of a
story, but we put together a new team.」

rows.speaker: Mel
rows.en: A team... don't tell me...
rows.display_text: 「A team... don't tell me...」

rows.speaker: Setsuko
rows.en: That's right. The new Glory Star.
rows.display_text: 「That's right. The new Glory Star.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Sounds like a lot's happened, but with a smile like that, I don't need to worry.
rows.display_text:
「Sounds like a lot's happened, but with
that smile, I don't need to worry.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: So, since you're all here, does that mean you're joining $c too?
rows.display_text:
「So, since you're here, does that mean
you're joining $c too?」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: Yeah... Lt. Quattro Bajeena scouted us.
rows.display_text: 「Yeah... Lt. Quattro Bajeena scouted us.」

rows.speaker: Toby
rows.en: Good to be working with you, repairman.
rows.display_text: 「Good to be working with you, repairman.」

rows.speaker: $n
rows.en: Just call me the Heat.
rows.display_text: 「Just call me the Heat.」

rows.speaker: Denzel
rows.en: That's a good smile. Sounds like you and I could share a good beer together.
rows.display_text:
「Good smile. Sounds like you and I could
share a good beer together.」

rows.speaker: Setsuko
rows.en: The Chief and Toby I met in the multiverse, from a parallel world...
rows.display_text:
（The Chief and Toby I met in the
multiverse, from a parallel world...）

rows.speaker: Setsuko
rows.en: They're different people from the two I once knew, but... I think that with them, I can find something new.
rows.display_text:
（They're different from the two I once
knew, but... I think with them, I can find
something new.）

rows.speaker: Setsuko
rows.en: The right qualities that only I possess... Carrying that mission and pride in my heart, we'll keep on fighting.
rows.display_text:
（The right qualities only I possess...
Carrying that mission and pride in my
heart, we'll keep fighting.）

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: So the Turn A ran out of control too...
rows.display_text: 「So the Turn A ran out of control too...」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Around the time the drones woke up all over the world, the Turn A started up on its own too, and used the Moonlight Butterfly with no one aboard.
rows.display_text:
「Drones woke worldwide; the Turn A
too woke unmanned, on its own, and used
the Moonlight Butterfly.」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: I got into the cockpit right away and shut it down, so it didn't turn into anything serious, though.
rows.display_text:
「I got into the cockpit right away and
shut it down, so it didn't turn into
anything serious.」

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: Could it be...?
rows.display_text: 「Could it be...?」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: Yeah... The Turn A might have that same system they call the Executor built into it too...
rows.display_text:
「Yeah... the Turn A might have that
same Executor system built into it too...」

rows.speaker: Sandman
rows.en: Gentlemen, assemble in the briefing room. It's time you all learned about the enemy we're up against.
rows.display_text:
「Gentlemen, assemble in the briefing
room. Time you all learned about the
enemy we're facing.」

rows.speaker: Eiji
rows.en: Just what I wanted to hear. Whatever they turn out to be, I won't forgive anyone who tramples on peace and happiness.
rows.display_text:
「Just what I wanted to hear. Whatever
they are, I won't forgive anyone who
tramples on peace and happiness.」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: Whoever it was that awakened the Black History's legacy... do we know their identity?
rows.display_text:
「Whoever awakened the Black History's
legacy... do we know their identity?」

rows.speaker: Loran
rows.en: And how exactly do the Turn A and King Gainer factor into this...?
rows.display_text:
（And how exactly do the Turn A and
King Gainer factor into this...?）

rows.speaker: Gainer
rows.en: What is this uneasy feeling...? Is King Gainer trying to tell me something...?
rows.display_text:
（What's this uneasy feeling...? Is King
Gainer trying to tell me something...?）
